#include <stddef.h>

#else

#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -5.5000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(18.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(32.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  // camera
  // eye: 0.000 1.600 3.800
  // target: 0.000 1.100 0.000
  // up: 0.000 1.000 0.000
  // fov: 45.000
  //
  // Recursive call-tree debug trace. Each nested branch() call emits a
  // console() message showing depth, segment length, and bend angle. The
  // Console panel auto-indents each line by call depth, providing a live
  // hierarchical trace of the recursion alongside the 3D geometry.
  static float levels = 3; // @tune
  static float len = 1.1; // @tune
  static float spread = 28; // @tune
  static float decay = 0.72; // @tune

  branch(depth, length, angle) {
    float sway, r, g, b;
    console("branch depth=%f len=%f angle=%f", depth, length, angle);
    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(angle, 0, 0, 1);
      glRotatef(angle * 0.4 + sin(t + depth) * 10, 0, 1, 0);
      r = 0.25 + (3 - depth) * 0.22;
      g = 0.85 - (3 - depth) * 0.15;
      b = 0.95 - (3 - depth) * 0.20;
      glColor3f(r, g, b);
      glBegin(GL_LINES);
        glVertex3f(0, 0, 0);
        glVertex3f(0, length, 0);
      glEnd();
      glTranslatef(0, length, 0);
      if(depth > 0) {
        sway = sin(t * 1.5 + depth) * 6;
        branch(depth - 1, length * decay, spread + sway);
        branch(depth - 1, length * decay, -spread - sway);
      }
      if(depth <= 0) {
        glColor3f(1, 0.85, 0.15);
        glutSolidSphere(0.06, 6, 4);
      }
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLineWidth(2.2);
  console("=== root t=%f levels=%f len=%f ===", t, levels, len);
  branch(levels, len, 0);
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
